reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Dispute tickets doubled from ~600/month (Jun–Jul) to 1180–1260 (Aug–Sep) while response times are within SLA, so the cause lies upstream in bill accuracy. Best-supported mechanism: manual reads are missed or late (route completion 0.88 vs 0.95, 9200 manual-read accounts), so billing substitutes estimates, and estimated bills drive part of the disputes (1240 of 3025). Estimates do not explain the 1785 ACTUAL-read disputes, which remain a separate open cause.
